locator.title: Наливной пол трескается и пылит? В чем может быть ошибка
locator.lead: Разбираем ошибки при заливке наливного пола, которые часто приводят к проблемам

nearest_text_before.text: Проблема: пропуск монтажа демпфера по периметру. Раствор расширяется при затвердевании, и если нет компенсации, возникают трещины.

nearest_text_after.text: Решение: установить демпферную ленту перед заливкой.

image_reading: A worker’s hand uses a black pressing tool to fit green foam damper tape along the wall-floor junction.
Part of the tape is already seated around the corner, while a loose section curves across the unfinished floor in the foreground.
The hand, tool, and flexible tape are the naturally movable elements; the corner junction is the key focal detail.
analysis.article_context: The body image illustrates the solution to “Ошибка №4. Отсутствие демпферной ленты”: installing perimeter expansion tape before pouring so the floor can expand without cracking.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Installing perimeter damper tape before pouring is a necessary preventive step that accommodates expansion and reduces the risk of cracks.
structured_intent.primary_action: The worker presses and guides the flexible damper tape into the wall-floor junction.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The visible section of tape is seated flush along the wall-floor junction and around the corner.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The tape remains a continuous protective separation layer along the floor perimeter before the pour.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, use a fixed close-up camera as the hand makes one steady pressing pass toward the corner. The tool advances at a moderate pace while the loose foam strip flexes and feeds into place. By the final frames, the visible section is firmly seated flush against the wall-floor junction.
models.positive_prompt: The hand steadily guides the black tool along the wall-floor junction, pressing the green damper tape firmly into the corner. The loose section bends and feeds forward naturally, ending with the tape seated flush along the visible perimeter.

models.scene_plan: Keep the camera fixed for the five-second shot. The hand performs one smooth, continuous installation pass, guiding the flexible strip around the corner with moderate pressure and even speed. The motion resolves near the end when the tape lies flush along the visible perimeter.
models.positive_prompt: The hand smoothly presses the green damper tape into the wall-floor junction with the tool as the loose strip flexes and follows. End with the visible tape fitted flush around the corner.

models.scene_plan: For four seconds, hold a fixed close-up on the hand, tool, and corner. Begin immediately with a short controlled pressing pass; the loose tape flexes naturally as it is guided into position. Finish near the end with the visible section seated flush around the corner.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed close-up: the hand makes one controlled pass with the tool, pressing the green damper tape into the wall-floor corner while the loose strip bends forward. In the final frame, the visible tape sits flush around the corner.
